items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: he came over where I played in Jersey, almost every week and bring his horn and get on the bandstand and we jammed together, we played together.

ctx.x: -- I like him very much. Cause he's doing the things -- he did the things that we used to do. He goes around and sits in with all of us. He comes over -- he came over where I played in Jersey, almost every week and bring his horn and get on the bandstand and we jammed together, we played together.
How do you spell his name?
